visible_text: 週次ブリーフィングを作る
2件のリソースから作成しました

observation.happening: Success toast notification confirming creation of weekly briefing from 2 resources
observation.most_important: Green checkmark + primary message make success state unambiguous
observation.next_action: User can open the briefing or copy its contents

C198.why: Polished success notification with clear state, but follows standard toast pattern seen across many platforms

observation.happening: Loading/preparation state indicator bar with escape shortcut hint
observation.most_important: Minimal visual design shows status + escape affordance
observation.next_action: User can press esc to cancel preparation

C487.why: Exemplary minimalism and clarity, but standard loading indicator pattern without distinguishing features

visible_text: macOS を先に出すことに決めました
Windows はいつ出しますか

observation.happening: Meeting notes interface showing structured breakdown of decisions (1), to-dos (0), and notes (2) with active attendee tracking
observation.most_important: Clear sectioning of decisions/to-dos/notes + real-time attendee sidebar showing who participated when
observation.next_action: User can expand note items, add to-dos, or engage with attendees listed

C7FA.why: Solid, well-organized notes interface with excellent hierarchy and state tracking, but follows familiar meeting app UX patterns

observation.happening: Plugin marketplace showing 10 available integrations in 2-column grid with colored letter avatars, version numbers, required permissions, and enabled status (green checkmarks)
observation.most_important: Each plugin clearly states name, version, permissions required, and activation status
observation.next_action: User can browse plugins or enable/disable them via checkmarks

ai_look: template repetition—every card identical structure (initial letter, name, version, permissions, checkmark)
D249.why: Clean, efficient plugin marketplace with good information density and consistent card design, but standard app marketplace pattern with slight template predictability

visible_text: マイクの許可がいただいたので、音声が記録されていません。
「設定を開く」でマイクを許可すると、ここに文字起こしが出ます。

observation.happening: Recording interface in progress (04:21 elapsed) but blocked by missing microphone permission; audio not being captured
observation.most_important: Prominent error alert explains why recording is silent + actionable CTA (設定を開く) to fix permission
observation.next_action: User must open settings and grant microphone permission to capture audio and begin transcription
anomalies: Large empty transcript area with instructional help text—intentional empty state design

D6D1.why: Exceptional error communication and empty state handling—explains problem and solution clearly without alarming tone. Follows meeting/call recording app UX conventions

observation.happening: AI processing/thinking indicator with animated dots and lightbulb icon
observation.most_important: Minimal visual communicates 'AI is thinking' without noise or distraction
observation.next_action: User waits for AI to complete processing

D9F0.why: Exemplary minimalism and calm tone for async AI operation, but thinking/processing indicator is a ubiquitous pattern across all AI products
